content:
New gamer, at what point do they shed instant fail missions?
Before anyone comes at me, I did do my research but want to verify with someone(s) who've actually played tha AC games instead of just Google AI

I only ever played the very first one way back when it came out. To start, im not a big stealth gamer. I like the Sly Cooper games but could never touch Tenchu, Splinter Cell or Metal Gear Solid for context.

I dont mind having to do stealth, what I hate however is instant fail stealth that fails you when detected. I prefer styles like the Metro games where you can do stealth and pivot to all out violence instead when detected.

So it seems all the AC games before Black Flag has instant fail pretty regularly, is that correct? As well, it sounds like the Black Flag coming up will remove the instant fail portion entirely?

I guess im just wondering is, for a gamer like me, whats a good point to jump into the series? Should I look at the Black Flag remaster as the jumping off point?
